348	   [mmtree_of_seq] over [uniq] seqs are well-formed, and this is the regime
349	   in which Stanley's psi_i is meaningful.

352	   has no [eqType] instance in this development. *)

354	  uniq (mmtree_to_seq t) /\ mmtree_of_seq (mmtree_to_seq t) = t.

361	Qed.

364	
365	   Swap the labels at positions [2*i] and [2*i+1] in the in-order word of [t],
366	   then reapply the min-max recursion.  On well-formed inputs this IS
367	   Stanley's operator (up to the indexing convention "internal vertex v_i is
368	   the 2i-th in-order label").  On malformed inputs it still returns a valid
369	   min-max tree, but there is no guarantee of involutivity since
370	   [mmtree_of_seq (mmtree_to_seq t) = t] fails. *)
371	Definition psi (i : nat) (t : mmtree T) : mmtree T :=
372	  mmtree_of_seq (swap_seq i (mmtree_to_seq t)).

386	Qed.

389	Proof.

392	by rewrite swap_seq_uniq.
393	Qed.

432	(*  Convention (inherited from M2, preserved here): the i-th internal vertex *)
433	(*  of a min-max tree corresponds to positions (2*i, 2*i+1) in the in-order  *)
434	(*  label word.  The operator [psi i] swaps those two positions and rebuilds *)
435	(*  the tree.  Consequently, the "descent-set toggle position" stated by     *)
436	(*  Stanley as "i" must, in our indexing, be read as the natural number      *)
437	(*  2*i (for type c) and 2*i-1 (for the extra type-d toggle) relative to    *)
438	(*  the descent-set indexing 'I_n of a length-(n+1) word.                    *)
439	(*                                                                            *)
440	(*  DELIVERABLES of this section                                              *)
441	(*  - [descent_set_seq s]     : descents of a uniq seq of ordinals.          *)
442	(*  - [descent_set_mmtree t]  : descents of mmtree_to_seq t.                 *)
443	(*  - [flips_in_swap]         : master characterization of the descent-set  *)
444	(*                              change induced by swap_pair_at (2*i).       *)
445	(*  - [descent_set_psi_c]     : type-c -> single toggle at 2*i.              *)
446	(*  - [descent_set_psi_d]     : type-d -> pair toggle at 2*i-1 and 2*i.      *)
447	(*                                                                            *)
448	(*  CONCEPTUAL LIMITATION.  In the M2 definition [psi i t] is the adjacent- *)
449	(*  transposition swap of positions (2*i, 2*i+1) inside the in-order label  *)
450	(*  word, not Stanley's full "right-subtree cyclic shift".  This placeholder *)
451	(*  coincides with Stanley's operator only in the restricted regime where   *)
452	(*  the i-th internal vertex has no left child AND its right child is a    *)
453	(*  leaf (i.e. the "e"-word vertex of rank exactly one), which is a *)
454	(*  degenerate case.  The sequence-level master lemma                        *)
455	(*  [descent_set_seq_swap_pair_at] below, however, is unconditionally       *)
456	(*  provable.  The two wrapper lemmas ask the CALLER to supply the local    *)
457	(*  seq-order pattern at positions (2*i-1, 2*i, 2*i+1, 2*i+2) via the       *)
458	(*  predicates [seq_type_c_at] / [seq_type_d_at].  These predicates are     *)
459	(*  weaker than the tree-level [is_node_c]/[is_node_d] applied at the       *)

465	   direct nat reasoning via lia.  The ordinal/label values are all distinct
466	   (by uniqueness), so we can case-split on the three pairwise orderings. *)
467	Lemma ltn_bool_prop (a b : nat) : (a < b)%N = true -> (a < b)%coq_nat.
468	Proof. by move/ssrnat.ltP. Qed.

473	Lemma desc_flip_lemma_v2 (a b c : nat) :
474	  a <> b -> a <> c -> b <> c ->
475	  (a < b)%N = (a < c)%N -> (b < a)%N = (c < a)%N.
476	Proof.
477	move=> Hab Hac Hbc Hh.
478	case Hab' : (a < b)%N Hh; case Hac' : (a < c)%N => //= _;
479	  case Hba : (b < a)%N; case Hca : (c < a)%N => //=; exfalso.
480	- by have := ltn_bool_prop Hab'; have := ltn_bool_prop Hba; lia.
481	- by have := ltn_bool_prop Hac'; have := ltn_bool_prop Hca; lia.
482	- (* Hab'=false, Hac'=false, Hba=true, Hca=false. b<=a, c<=a, b<a, a<=c. *)
483	  have Ha' := leqn_bool_prop Hab'.   (* b<=a *)
484	  have Hc' := leqn_bool_prop Hac'.   (* c<=a *)
485	  have Hb' := ltn_bool_prop Hba.     (* b<a *)
486	  have Hd' := leqn_bool_prop Hca.    (* a<=c *)
487	  by apply: Hac; lia.
488	- (* Hab'=false, Hac'=false, Hba=false, Hca=true. b<=a, c<=a, a<=b, c<a. *)
489	  have Ha' := leqn_bool_prop Hab'.
490	  have Hc' := leqn_bool_prop Hac'.
491	  have Hb' := leqn_bool_prop Hba.
492	  have Hd' := ltn_bool_prop Hca.
493	  by apply: Hab; lia.
494	Qed.

497	  x <> y -> x <> z -> y <> z ->

505	- by move: (ltn_bool_prop Hyz') (ltn_bool_prop Hzy'); lia.
506	- have Hax := leqn_bool_prop Hxz'.
507	  have Hay := leqn_bool_prop Hyz'.
508	  have Hbx := ltn_bool_prop Hzx'.
509	  have Hby := leqn_bool_prop Hzy'.
510	  apply: Hyz; lia.
511	- have Hax := leqn_bool_prop Hxz'.
512	  have Hay := leqn_bool_prop Hyz'.
513	  have Hbx := leqn_bool_prop Hzx'.
514	  have Hby := ltn_bool_prop Hzy'.
515	  apply: Hxz; lia.

520	  (y < z)%N != (x < z)%N -> (z < x)%N != (z < y)%N.

603	   We state the effect pointwise on each [k : 'I_n]: for k whose descent
604	   pair [(val k, val k.+1)] is disjoint from the swapped pair [(p, p.+1)],

612	(* For positions untouched by the swap, membership in the descent set is
613	   unchanged.                                                            *)
614	Lemma nth_swap_pair_at_far (T : Type) (x0 : T) (p q : nat) (s : seq T) :
615	  q <> p -> q <> p.+1 ->
616	  nth x0 (swap_pair_at p s) q = nth x0 s q.
617	Proof.
618	elim: p s q => [|p IHp] s q.
619	  case: s => [|a [|b s']] //= Hq0 Hq1.
620	  by case: q Hq0 Hq1 => [|[|q']] // _ _.
621	case: s => [|a s'] //.
622	case: q => [|q'] //= Hq0 Hq1.
623	by rewrite IHp // => Heq; [apply: Hq0 | apply: Hq1]; rewrite Heq.
624	Qed.

626	Lemma descent_set_seq_swap_far s p (k : 'I_n) :
627	  (val k).+1 < p \/ p.+1 < val k ->
628	  (k \in descent_set_seq (swap_pair_at p s)) =
629	  (k \in descent_set_seq s).
630	Proof.
631	move=> Hfar; rewrite !mem_descent_set_seq.
632	have lem : forall q, q = val k \/ q = (val k).+1 -> q <> p /\ q <> p.+1.
633	  move=> q Hq.
634	  have Hqk : q <= (val k).+1 /\ val k <= q.
635	    by case: Hq => ->; split; [apply: leqnSn|apply: leqnn
636	                               |apply: leqnn|apply: leqnSn].
637	  split=> Hqp; case: Hqk => Hq1 Hq2; case: Hfar => H.
638	  (* Case q=p, Hq1: q <= (val k).+1, H: (val k).+1 < p. Then q < p, but q = p. *)
639	  - have Hlt := leq_ltn_trans Hq1 H; rewrite Hqp in Hlt.
640	    by move: Hlt; rewrite ltnn.
641	  (* Case q=p, Hq2: val k <= q, H: p.+1 < val k. Then p.+1 < q, but q = p. *)
642	  - have Hlt : p.+1 < q := leq_trans H Hq2. rewrite Hqp in Hlt.
643	    by move: Hlt; rewrite ltnNge leqnSn.
644	  (* Case q=p.+1, Hq1, H: (val k).+1 < p. q < p, so q.+1 <= p; but q = p.+1. *)
645	  - have Hlt := leq_ltn_trans Hq1 H; rewrite Hqp in Hlt.
646	    by move: Hlt; rewrite ltnNge leqnSn.
647	  (* Case q=p.+1, Hq2, H: p.+1 < val k. p.+1 < q, so q=p.+1 contradicts. *)
648	  - have Hlt : p.+1 < q := leq_trans H Hq2. rewrite Hqp in Hlt.
649	    by move: Hlt; rewrite ltnn.
650	have [H1 H2] : val k <> p /\ val k <> p.+1 by apply: lem; left.
651	have [H3 H4] : (val k).+1 <> p /\ (val k).+1 <> p.+1 by apply: lem; right.
652	rewrite (@nth_swap_pair_at_far _ ord0 p (val k) s H1 H2).
653	by rewrite (@nth_swap_pair_at_far _ ord0 p (val k).+1 s H3 H4).
654	Qed.

657	   toggles under a uniq-preserving swap_pair_at p, since the two entries
658	   are distinct and strictly ordered. *)
659	Lemma nth_swap_pair_at_lo (T : Type) (x0 : T) p (s : seq T) :
660	  p.+1 < size s -> nth x0 (swap_pair_at p s) p = nth x0 s p.+1.
661	Proof.
662	elim: p s => [|p IHp] s Hp /=.
663	  by case: s Hp => [|a [|b s']] //=.
664	case: s Hp => [|a s'] //= Hp.
665	by rewrite IHp.
666	Qed.
667	
668	Lemma nth_swap_pair_at_hi (T : Type) (x0 : T) p (s : seq T) :
669	  p.+1 < size s -> nth x0 (swap_pair_at p s) p.+1 = nth x0 s p.
670	Proof.
671	elim: p s => [|p IHp] s Hp /=.
672	  by case: s Hp => [|a [|b s']] //=.
673	case: s Hp => [|a s'] //= Hp.
674	by rewrite IHp.
675	Qed.
676	
677	Lemma descent_set_seq_swap_mid s p (k : 'I_n) :
678	  uniq s -> (val k = p) -> p.+1 < size s ->
679	  (k \in descent_set_seq (swap_pair_at p s)) =

680	  ~~ (k \in descent_set_seq s).
681	Proof.
682	move=> Hu Hk Hp.
683	rewrite !mem_descent_set_seq Hk.
684	rewrite (@nth_swap_pair_at_lo _ ord0 p s Hp)

716	(* [seq_type_c_at s i] holds when, in the uniq seq [s], the adjacent pair
717	   at positions (2i, 2i+1) is a "type-c swap" in the sense that the only
718	   descent bit affected by swapping these two entries is at position 2i.

720	   Concretely: for every [k : 'I_n] with [val k = (2*i).-1] (i.e.
721	   [val k + 1 = 2*i]), the descent bit at [k] is unchanged by the swap;
722	   similarly for [val k = (2*i).+1].                                       *)

724	  (if (2 * i) isn't p.+1 then true else
725	     (nth ord0 s p < nth ord0 s p.+1)%N ==
726	     (nth ord0 s p < nth ord0 s p.+2)%N) &&
727	  ((nth ord0 s (2 * i).+1 < nth ord0 s (2 * i).+2)%N ==
728	   (nth ord0 s (2 * i) < nth ord0 s (2 * i).+2)%N).

731	   position 2*i-1 FLIPS under the swap (type-d toggle on the left), while
732	   the descent bit at position 2*i+1 remains fixed.                       *)
733	Definition seq_type_d_at (s : seq 'I_n.+1) (i : nat) : bool :=
734	  (if (2 * i) isn't p.+1 then false else
735	     (nth ord0 s p < nth ord0 s p.+1)%N !=
736	     (nth ord0 s p < nth ord0 s p.+2)%N) &&
737	  ((nth ord0 s (2 * i).+1 < nth ord0 s (2 * i).+2)%N ==
738	   (nth ord0 s (2 * i) < nth ord0 s (2 * i).+2)%N).

763	Lemma descent_set_psi_c t (i : nat) (H2i : 2 * i < n) :

766	  (2 * i).+2 < size (mmtree_to_seq t) ->

781	    by apply: ltn_trans Hsize.

802	  - right.
803	    have : (val k).+1 = 2 * i.
804	      by apply/eqP; rewrite eqn_leq Hnear Hlt.
805	    by move=> ->.
806	  - left.
807	    have : val k = (2 * i).+1.
808	      by apply/eqP; rewrite eqn_leq Hnear2 Hlt.
809	    by move=> ->.

811	- (* val k = (2*i).+1 *)
812	  rewrite !mem_descent_set_seq Hk1 /=.
813	  have HSi_lt : (2 * i).+1 < size (mmtree_to_seq t) by apply: ltn_trans Hsize.
814	  rewrite (@nth_swap_pair_at_hi _ ord0 (2 * i) (mmtree_to_seq t) HSi_lt).
815	  have H_ne_2iSS_2iS : (2 * i).+2 <> (2 * i).+1 by lia.
816	  have H_ne_2iSS_2i : (2 * i).+2 <> 2 * i by lia.
817	  rewrite (@nth_swap_pair_at_far _ ord0 (2 * i) (2 * i).+2 (mmtree_to_seq t)
818	            H_ne_2iSS_2i H_ne_2iSS_2iS).
819	  case/andP: Hc => _ /eqP Hc2.
820	  (* Need: (nth s (2i).+2 < nth s (2i)) = (nth s (2i).+2 < nth s (2i).+1) *)

822	  have H2i_lt : 2 * i < size (mmtree_to_seq t) := ltnW HSi_lt.
823	  have HSSi_lt : (2 * i).+2 < size (mmtree_to_seq t) := Hsize.
824	  (* For the proof we need the three pairwise-distinct values; uniqueness gives
825	     this whenever the indices are in range. *)
826	  have Hne_ab : nth ord0 (mmtree_to_seq t) (2 * i) !=
827	                nth ord0 (mmtree_to_seq t) (2 * i).+1.
828	    rewrite nth_uniq //.
829	    by rewrite neq_ltn ltnSn.
830	  have Hne_ac : nth ord0 (mmtree_to_seq t) (2 * i) !=
831	                nth ord0 (mmtree_to_seq t) (2 * i).+2.
832	    rewrite nth_uniq //.
833	    by rewrite neq_ltn ltnW.

835	                nth ord0 (mmtree_to_seq t) (2 * i).+2.
836	    rewrite nth_uniq //.
837	    by rewrite neq_ltn ltnSn.
838	  apply: desc_flip_lemma.

840	  - move=> Heq; move/eqP: Hne_ac => /(_ (val_inj Heq)) //.
841	  - move=> Heq; move/eqP: Hne_bc => /(_ (val_inj Heq)) //.

844	  set p := val k.
845	  have Hp1 : p.+1 = 2 * i by rewrite /p; symmetry; exact: Hk1.
846	  rewrite !mem_descent_set_seq -/p /=.
847	  (* nth at p unchanged (p < 2*i). *)
848	  have HSi_lt : (2 * i).+1 < size (mmtree_to_seq t) by apply: ltn_trans Hsize.
849	  have Hp1_lt : p.+1 < size (mmtree_to_seq t).

860	              nth ord0 (mmtree_to_seq t) (2 * i).+1.

862	    by rewrite (@nth_swap_pair_at_lo _ ord0 (2 * i) (mmtree_to_seq t) HSi_lt).
863	  rewrite E_p1.

866	     Hc's first conjunct: 2*i = p.+1 isn't 0, so:
867	       (nth s p < nth s p.+1) = (nth s p < nth s p.+2). *)
868	  case/andP: Hc => Hc1 _.
869	  move: Hc1; rewrite -Hp1 /= => /eqP Hc1.
870	  have Hne_ab : nth ord0 (mmtree_to_seq t) p !=
871	                nth ord0 (mmtree_to_seq t) p.+1.
872	    rewrite nth_uniq //.
873	    by rewrite neq_ltn ltnSn.
874	  have Hne_ac : nth ord0 (mmtree_to_seq t) p !=
875	                nth ord0 (mmtree_to_seq t) p.+2.
876	    rewrite nth_uniq //.
877	    by rewrite neq_ltn ltnW.
878	  have Hne_bc : nth ord0 (mmtree_to_seq t) p.+1 !=
879	                nth ord0 (mmtree_to_seq t) p.+2.
880	    rewrite nth_uniq //.
881	    by rewrite neq_ltn ltnSn.
882	  (* (2 * i).+1 = p.+2 definitionally via Hp1; should already be folded. *)
883	  (* Now goal: (nth s p.+2 < nth s p) = (nth s p.+1 < nth s p).
884	     Equivalent: (c < a) = (b < a), given (a < b) = (a < c) [Hc1].
885	     Use desc_flip_lemma after symmetry: swap roles. *)
886	  apply: desc_flip_lemma_v2.
887	  - move=> Heq; move/eqP: Hne_ac => /(_ (val_inj Heq)) //.
888	  - move=> Heq; move/eqP: Hne_ab => /(_ (val_inj Heq)) //.
889	  - move=> Heq; move/eqP: Hne_bc.
890	    by apply; apply: val_inj.
891	  - by symmetry.
892	Qed.

930	    by case: (2 * i) H2i_pos => [//|p _]; lia.

976	    - move=> Heq; move/eqP: Hne_ac => /(_ (val_inj Heq)) //.

Proof. exact: well_formed_psi. Qed.

  well_formed t ->
  mmtree_to_seq (psi_stanley i t) = swap_seq i (mmtree_to_seq t).
Proof. exact: mmtree_to_seq_psi. Qed.

  well_formed t -> psi_stanley i (psi_stanley i t) = t.
Proof. exact: psi_involutive. Qed.

  well_formed t -> i <> j ->
  psi_stanley i (psi_stanley j t) = psi_stanley j (psi_stanley i t).

Implicit Types (t : mmtree 'I_n.+1) (i : nat).
